title: Tamarack
summary: Not sure if there are any Tamarack trees within the scope of this shot from inside Biidaasige Park's recent extension, but the bright white-and-orange M/V Tamarack features prominently in the middle-background, docked at the Amrize cement plant seen right behind it in Toromto's Port Lands. The Tamarack was built specially by Eureka Shipping to carry cement on the Great Lakes.
